_note: Curated grammatical hints, shown to the translator on the 'Grammar:' line of an
expanded segment's comment. CLDR does not publish anything of this kind: a plural
category is a selector, not a description of the grammar a form requires, so this
content is editorial and has to be written and reviewed by linguists.
Who authors and reviews it is open question Q11 in the design document, and until
that is settled this file is deliberately close to empty. The single entry below is
the one the design document itself uses in its worked example; it is here so the
comment builder is exercised end to end, and it has not been through linguistic
review. Do not read the sparseness as a gap to be filled by guesswork.
